page.metaTitle: Environmental Data Monitoring — EPA, Air Quality & Climate | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track EPA enforcement actions, air quality readings, climate-data dashboards, and environmental rule changes with automated alerts.
page.subtitle: Track EPA enforcement actions, air quality indices, water-quality dashboards, climate data publications, and environmental rulemaking.
page.intro: Environmental researchers, public-health teams, NGO advocates, and industry compliance teams track environmental data across federal, state, and international sources. WebMonitor.fyi monitors the public dashboards and rule pages — EPA enforcement records, EPA air quality readings, NOAA climate data, state environmental agency portals, and international equivalents.

setup.title: Pick the data sources
setup.body: EPA ECHO for enforcement records, AirNow for air quality, EPA rule pages for regulatory activity, NOAA for climate data, state DEQ portals for state-level enforcement.

setup.title: Set criteria for the changes that matter
setup.body: Examples: "alert me on new enforcement actions in [my state]", "notify me when air quality in [my zip] exceeds [threshold]", "let me know when this rule moves to final".

setup.title: Daily checks for most environmental data
setup.body: Environmental data updates on daily-to-weekly cycles; daily checks catch changes with appropriate lead time.

examples: Public health teams monitoring air and water quality
Industry compliance teams tracking enforcement activity in their sector
NGO advocates monitoring EPA and state DEQ activity
page.limits: Environmental data monitoring covers public dashboards and reports. Real-time sensor data feeds (some air quality monitoring networks) are better served by their native APIs. WebMonitor catches the dashboard updates and report publications.

faq.q: Can I monitor EPA enforcement against specific facilities?
faq.a: Yes. EPA ECHO has facility-specific search results URLs. Monitor those for new enforcement records.

faq.q: Does this work for climate data publications?
faq.a: Yes. NOAA, NASA, and international climate agency dashboards work as monitor URLs.

faq.q: Can I track water quality data?
faq.a: Yes. EPA Drinking Water Reporting and state water quality dashboards work as monitor URLs.
